headline: Nigeria Partners US Firm Valmont to Establish Irrigation Equipment Plant
summary: The Nigerian federal government partnered with Nebraska-based Valmont Industries to build an irrigation manufacturing plant in Nigeria to reduce reliance on imported agricultural systems.
why: Valmont Industries is a NYSE-listed global producer of mechanized irrigation systems and industrial infrastructure.

impacts.name: Valmont Industries
impacts.why: Valmont partnered with the Nigerian government to construct a local irrigation machinery plant.
